title: Dormancy and Closure of a Wanderlane Traveller Club Membership
content:
**Clause 1. Dormancy.** A Wanderlane Traveller Club membership with no activity at all for the inactivity term of the tier held falls dormant, and falling dormant sweeps the spendable balance. The term read is the inactivity term of the tier the member holds, and the condition is complete inactivity: any activity at all on the membership within the term keeps it from falling dormant on that term.

**Clause 2. Closure is the member's own act.** Only the member may close their own card, and closure forfeits every point on it with no payment of any kind; the agency records the request and the member confirms it. No point on a closed card is bought back, converted, refunded or carried anywhere.

**Clause 3. A closed card is final.** A closed card is never reopened: a traveller who wishes to rejoin is enrolled afresh at the entry tier with nothing carried over.

## The two ends of a membership compared

| How the membership ends | What brings it about | What becomes of the spendable balance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| It falls dormant | No activity at all for the inactivity term of the tier held | The spendable balance is swept |
| It is closed | Only the member may close their own card | Every point on it is forfeited, with no payment of any kind |

## Points of judgement

*A member asks the desk to close a relative's card on their behalf.* Only the member may close their own card.

*A member who closed a card last year asks for it back, with their old tier and balance.* A closed card is never reopened. A traveller who wishes to rejoin is enrolled afresh at the entry tier with nothing carried over.

*A member asks to be paid out for the points they are giving up on closure.* Closure forfeits every point on the card with no payment of any kind.
